mapper.select: SELECT cert.emp15_cert_id AS cert_id, cert.emp15_issue_date AS issue_date, cert.emp15_link_cd AS link_code, f_cdnm('LinkCode', cert.emp15_link_cd, cert.emp15_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS link_name, cert.emp15_person_id AS person_id, per.emp01_emp_no AS person_no, f_emp_kor_nm(cert.emp15_person_id) AS person_name, cert.emp15_cert_use_cd AS cert_use_code, cert.emp15_cert_use AS cert_use, (CASE WHEN cert.emp15_cert_use_cd = '9' THEN cert.emp15_cert_use ELSE f_cdnm('CertUseCode', cert.emp15_cert_use_cd, cert.emp15_company_id, f_sysdate()) END) AS cert_use_name, cert.emp15_dcr_class_tree_id AS dcr_class_tree_id, cert.emp15_appr_id AS appr_id, appr.apr01_stamp_seq AS stamp_seq_text, COALESCE(f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', appr.apr01_status_cd, cert.emp15_company_id, f_sysdate()), '') AS appr_status_name, per.emp01_email_addr AS email_address FROM emp15_cert cert LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr appr ON cert.emp15_appr_id = appr.apr01_appr_id INNER JOIN sys01_company com ON cert.emp15_company_id = com.sys01_company_id INNER JOIN emp01_person per ON cert.emp15_person_id = per.emp01_person_id WHERE cert.emp15_company_id = #{companyId} AND cert.emp15_issue_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} ORDER BY cert.emp15_issue_date DESC, cert.emp15_link_cd, cert.emp15_appr_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp15_cert (emp15_cert_id, emp15_company_id, emp15_issue_date, emp15_link_cd, emp15_person_id, emp15_cert_use_cd, emp15_cert_use, emp15_dcr_class_tree_id) VALUES (#{certId}, #{companyId}, #{issueDate}, #{linkCode}, #{personId}, #{certUseCode}, #{certUse}, #{dcrClassTreeId})
mapper.select: SELECT cert.emp15_cert_id AS cert_id , cert.emp15_issue_date AS issue_date , cert.emp15_link_cd AS link_code , per.emp01_emp_no AS person_no , per.emp01_hire_date AS hire_date , com.sys01_company_nm AS company_name , '(' || COALESCE(com.sys01_zip_cd,'') || ')' || COALESCE(com.sys01_zip_addr,'') || COALESCE(com.sys01_zip_detail,'') AS company_address , (SELECT emp02_birthday FROM emp02_others WHERE emp02_person_id = emp01_person_id) AS birth_day , (SELECT to_decrypts(emp02_ctz_no) FROM emp02_others WHERE emp02_person_id = emp01_person_id) AS person_ctz_no , (SELECT '(' || COALESCE(emp02_zip_cd,'') || ')' || COALESCE(emp02_zip_addr,'') || ' ' || COALESCE(emp02_addr_detail,'') FROM emp02_others WHERE emp02_person_id = emp15_person_id) AS person_address , (SELECT f_org_nm(emp03_org_code_id, emp15_issue_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = emp15_person_id AND emp03_trans_date IN (SELECT MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = emp15_person_id AND emp03_trans_date <= emp15_issue_date)) AS org_name , (SELECT f_emp_kor_nm(emp01_person_id) FROM emp03_trans INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = emp03_person_id WHERE emp03_pos_cd = '100' AND emp01_company_id = emp15_company_id AND emp03_trans_date <= emp15_issue_date LIMIT 1) AS company_agent , (CASE WHEN cert.emp15_cert_use_cd = '9' THEN cert.emp15_cert_use ELSE f_cdnm('CertUseCode', cert.emp15_cert_use_cd, cert.emp15_company_id, f_sysdate()) END) AS cert_use_name , f_cdnm('LinkCode', cert.emp15_link_cd, cert.emp15_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS link_name , f_emp_kor_nm(cert.emp15_person_id) AS person_name , f_get_emptrans(cert.emp15_person_id, cert.emp15_issue_date, 'pos_nm') AS person_pos , f_get_emptrans(cert.emp15_person_id, cert.emp15_issue_date, 'title_nm') AS person_title , f_get_emptrans(cert.emp15_person_id, cert.emp15_issue_date, 'retire_date') AS retire_date , COALESCE((SELECT STRING_AGG( '<' || 'br' || '>' || ' 조치기관 : ' || emp11_reward_group::text || '<' || 'br' || '>' || ' 징계일자 : ' || TO_CHAR(emp11_reward_dt,'yyyy-MM-dd')::text || '<' || 'br' || '>' || ' 징계사유 : ' || emp11_reward_nm::text || '<' || 'br' || '>' || ' 징계처분 : ' || emp11_reward_desc::text || '<' || 'br' || '>', '<' || 'br' || '>') FROM emp11_reward WHERE emp11_person_id = cert.emp15_person_id AND emp11_reward_cd = '20' AND emp11_reward_dt <= cert.emp15_issue_date), '') AS reward_list , (SELECT STRING_AGG(emp03.trans_list, '<' || 'br' || '>' ORDER BY emp03.trans_list) FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS row_num , (TO_CHAR(e.emp03_trans_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd')::text || ' ~ ' || (SELECT COALESCE(TO_CHAR(MIN(a.emp03_trans_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'), TO_CHAR(cert.emp15_issue_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) FROM emp03_trans a WHERE a.emp03_person_id = cert.emp15_person_id AND e.emp03_trans_date < a.emp03_trans_date)::text || ' ' || f_org_nm(e.emp03_org_code_id, e.emp03_trans_date)::text || COALESCE(' (' || (SELECT a.org02_note FROM org02_info a WHERE a.org02_code_id = e.emp03_org_code_id AND a.org02_mod_date = (SELECT MAX(x.org02_mod_date) FROM org02_info x WHERE x.org02_code_id = a.org02_code_id AND x.org02_mod_date <= e.emp03_trans_date) ) || ')', '') ) AS trans_list FROM emp03_trans e WHERE e.emp03_person_id = cert.emp15_person_id AND e.emp03_trans_date <= cert.emp15_issue_date AND e.emp03_trans_cd != '900' ) emp03) AS trans_list FROM emp15_cert cert INNER JOIN sys01_company com ON cert.emp15_company_id = com.sys01_company_id INNER JOIN emp01_person per ON cert.emp15_person_id = per.emp01_person_id WHERE cert.emp15_company_id = #{companyId} AND cert.emp15_cert_id = #{certId}
